(prob. corrupted fr. √ व्रज्) cl. 1. P. वजति (pf. ववाज fut. वजिता &c. Gr.), to go, Dhātup. vii, 78:
Caus. or cl. 10. P. वाजयति, to prepare the way, to trim or feather an arrow (मार्ग-, or मार्गण-संस्कारे), Dhātup. xxxii, 74. Another √ वज् or उज्, ‘to be hard or strong’, may be inferred from उग्र, ओजस्, वज्र, वाज (qq.vv.), the last of which gave rise to the Nom. वाजय, q.v. [For cognate words, see under उग्र and ओजस्.]
